title: 通胀超标65个月：美联储仍不认趋势，9月会议会否行动？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Are you satisfied with this speech? Did it give you confidence that this fed chair was prepared to hike rates in the face of 65 straight months of above-target inflation?
segments.zh: 你对这次讲话满意吗？它是否让你相信，这位美联储主席准备在通胀连续65个月高于目标的情况下加息？

segments.en: Well, I think so. I think the work to do, quote, that you mentioned, is the money, quote, and I think that it delivered the reaction that the chair wanted. In particular, he also highlighted
segments.zh: 嗯，我想是的。我认为你提到的“要做的工作”就是“钱”，而且我认为它达到了主席想要的效果。特别是，他还强调

segments.en: that the recent improving inflation data to him did not represent, you know, he was not confident that was the trend. And so I think every meeting, including September, is live. But I think also
segments.zh: 最近通胀数据改善，但在他看来，他并不确信这是趋势。所以我认为每次会议，包括9月，都是“现场直播”。但我也认为

segments.en: that's about as much as we're going to get out of the chairman in terms of his reaction function that there may be work to do. I was surprised that he leaned so heavily into the 2%
segments.zh: 关于他的反应函数，我们最多只能得到这些，可能还有工作要做。我惊讶于他如此强调2%的

segments.en: PCE objective is a firm fixed target and the fact that we did hear from the fed chair granular analysis of the components going into PCE and how broad-based inflation was. Which does that give
segments.zh: PCE目标是坚定的固定目标，而且我们确实听到美联储主席对PCE组成部分以及通胀的广泛性进行了细致分析。这是否让你

segments.en: you a sense that maybe this isn't somebody looking to overhaul inflation measurements, inflation targets, the way some people were expecting? I think the my interpretation is the chairman wants
segments.zh: 觉得这个人可能不像一些人预期的那样想要彻底改革通胀衡量和通胀目标？我认为我的解读是，主席想要

segments.en: better measurements and better forecasts, but he made clear that the target by which the fed will be judged as the existing target, which is 2% PCE inflation, which of course was, there was some
segments.zh: 更好的衡量和更好的预测，但他明确表示，美联储将被评判的目标是现有的目标，即2%的PCE通胀，当然，这有些

segments.en: confusion about that coming out of the July press conference. You know, Rich Claret, I remember
segments.zh: 在7月新闻发布会后出现了混乱。你知道，Rich Claret，我记得
